summary.business_type: Local building-materials manufacturer + roofing contractor (hybrid storefront/service-area), bilingual TH/EN, Astro static site
top_findings: Zero structured data on every page (no Organization/LocalBusiness/Product/Article/Breadcrumb JSON-LD)
No robots.txt and no XML sitemap; @astrojs/sitemap not installed
No canonical, no hreflang, no OG/Twitter tags on a bilingual TH/EN site (BaseLayout.astro head)
No published street address and no Google Business Profile signal - blocks local ranking and citations
Price opacity: every product/spec row says 'สอบถามราคา' - kills snippet + AI Overview eligibility for highest-volume commercial queries
Thin money pages: /specifications 193 words, /products one sentence per model, vs 1,000-2,500 word competitor norm
Hero LCP image ships loading=lazy + fetchpriority=auto; render-blocking Google Fonts (2 Thai families, 7-8 weights)
Trailing-slash duplicates: /about and /about/ both 200 with identical body, no redirect (Vercel routing)
Trust proof (team, testimonials, มอก., reg number, factory photos) empty or off the money pages
Mobile: wordmark collides with hamburger; hero image pushes offer + CTA below the fold; sticky bar overlaps CTA; 3 CLIENT WORK images render blank
quick_wins: Add public/robots.txt (allow-all + AI crawler allow + Sitemap: line)
pnpm add @astrojs/sitemap + i18n config (defaultLocale th, locales th/en) -> emits sitemap with hreflang
Add canonical + hreflang th/en/x-default + OG/Twitter tags to BaseLayout.astro head (~15 lines, all pages)
Add priority (loading=eager + fetchpriority=high) to hero <Image> on TH + EN home - one-word LCP fix
Add Organization + WebSite JSON-LD @graph in BaseLayout (one <Schema> component, data already in site.ts)
vercel.json: trailingSlash:false redirect + X-Content-Type-Options / Referrer-Policy headers
Guard /en/ homepage testimonials block with length>0 to kill empty-section render bug
noindex the 'เร็ว ๆ นี้' stub pages (Promotions/Vision/Maps/Hours) and 7 comingSoon products
Remove unused @astrojs/react / dead 192KB client.*.js (zero client:* islands) or document intent
summary.notes_on_method: No Google API credentials (no CrUX/GSC/GA4 field data) - CWV is single-run lab only. No DataForSEO/live SERP - local pack positions, citation NAP consistency, competitor proximity, and whether a GBP already exists could not be verified. Proximity (~55% of local ranking variance) not assessable without the real street address.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Pure static SSR output, is_spa:false, no hydration, no long tasks
Clean URLs, unique titles/descriptions/H1s
Valid HTTPS + HSTS + brotli + HTTP/2, correct mobile viewport
Correct 404 status code from Vercel

findings.title: No robots.txt
findings.description: /robots.txt 404s; no crawl directives, no Sitemap discovery path on a near-zero-backlink domain.
findings.recommendation: Add public/robots.txt: allow-all, explicit AI-crawler allow (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended), Sitemap: https://.../sitemap-index.xml

findings.title: No XML sitemap
findings.description: /sitemap.xml and variants 404; @astrojs/sitemap not in deps. ~28 pages + 3 blog posts have no discovery aid.
findings.recommendation: pnpm add @astrojs/sitemap; configure i18n (defaultLocale th, locales {th,en}); rebuild; submit to GSC + Bing.

findings.title: No canonical tags
findings.description: grep rel=canonical in dist/ = 0; not in BaseLayout.astro.
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel=canonical href={Astro.url}> in BaseLayout head.

findings.title: Trailing-slash duplicate URLs
findings.description: /about and /about/ both return 200 with identical body md5 and no redirect; Vercel filesystem routing overrides astro trailingSlash:'never'. No vercel.json.
findings.recommendation: Add vercel.json with trailingSlash:false (301 redirect); pair with canonical tags.

findings.title: No hreflang
findings.description: Bilingual TH/EN site with zero <link rel=alternate hreflang>. Language pairing exists only as a visible header toggle.
findings.recommendation: Emit reciprocal th / en / x-default hreflang in BaseLayout head and in the sitemap.

findings.title: Hero (LCP element) is lazy-loaded
findings.description: src/pages/index.astro <Image> hero has no priority; loading=lazy, fetchpriority=auto. Direct mobile LCP hit (lab LCP 2.9s mobile home, 3.3s products).
findings.recommendation: Add priority to hero <Image> (TH + EN); add <link rel=preload as=image> for hero + first product image.

findings.title: Render-blocking cross-origin Google Fonts
findings.description: Two heavy Thai families (IBM Plex Sans Thai + Noto Sans Thai), 7-8 weight files, ~770-870ms render-blocking. public/fonts/ exists but is empty (abandoned self-host).
findings.recommendation: Self-host + subset to Thai+Latin, drop one family, ship 2-3 weights, preload the critical face, keep font-display:swap.

findings.title: No OG / Twitter tags
findings.description: No og:title/description/image or twitter:card. Breaks LINE and Facebook link previews - the business's primary channels.
findings.recommendation: Add OG + Twitter meta in BaseLayout from title/description props + a default og:image (1200x630).

findings.title: No custom 404 page
findings.description: Generic Vercel dead-end (status code is correct).
findings.recommendation: Add src/pages/404.astro wrapping BaseLayout with nav back to key pages.

findings.title: Partial security headers
findings.description: Only HSTS present. Missing X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP.
findings.recommendation: Set headers in vercel.json.

findings.title: Dead React runtime shipped
findings.description: @astrojs/react built a 192KB dist/_astro/client.*.js referenced by zero pages - no client:* islands exist (Phosphor icons use /ssr import).
findings.recommendation: Remove @astrojs/react integration, or document the intent to add islands.

findings.title: No robots meta control / no IndexNow
findings.description: No per-page noindex mechanism; stub pages are indexable. No IndexNow ping for fast recrawl.
findings.recommendation: Add an optional noindex prop to BaseLayout; consider IndexNow after sitemap lands.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Deliberate anti-fabrication stance - copy is specific, human, honest (low AI-slop risk)
Real geography and process vocabulary (cut-to-length on site, Friendship Bridge, upper-Isan)
Clean heading hierarchy and solid Thai B2B readability
Real product taxonomy and a large (1,295-photo) genuine job-photo gallery
manim concept diagrams for technical explanation

findings.title: Team page is empty
findings.description: team.ts = []. No named experts or credentials, though the whole pitch is 'our technical team does your take-off'.
findings.recommendation: Publish 2-4 real team members with role, years, and any engineer licence; surface a short version on /services and /about.

findings.title: No certification / standards evidence
findings.description: มอก./TIS, steel grade, coating mass, PU density, fire rating absent sitewide (grep = 0). /about 'standards' section is generic unverifiable claims.
findings.recommendation: Add a standards page with real มอก. numbers, coating class (AZ/Z), BMT/TCT, PU density, and scans/photos of certificates.

findings.title: Factory proof is placeholder
findings.description: src/assets/photos/ has no facility/production/crew/delivery images; /about and /services render striped placeholder divs. A 'factory-standard manufacturer' shows no factory.
findings.recommendation: Shoot and publish 15-25 real facility/line/crew/loading photos with descriptive captions.

findings.title: Contact & legal trust gaps
findings.description: No street address (province only), no map, no hours, no หจก. registration number, no email, no written warranty term.
findings.recommendation: Publish full NAP + hours + registration number + a one-line warranty statement on /contact and footer.

findings.title: /specifications thin and price-blank
findings.description: 193 words; every startingPrice blank while the page title promises 'ราคาเริ่มต้น'. No BMT/TCT, coating mass, span tables, R-value.
findings.recommendation: Expand to a 1,200+ word pillar with real spec tables and starting ฿/ตร.ม. ranges, or retitle if price can't be shown.

findings.title: Product pages thin + placeholder entries
findings.description: One sentence per model; 7 identical 'coming soon' entries are indexable.
findings.recommendation: 150-300 words per real model (profile, use case, spec range, colours, min order); noindex the comingSoon entries.

findings.title: Blog thin and stalled
findings.description: 3 short posts, none since 2026-06-12, no author, no schema, no sources, no cover images.
findings.recommendation: Add author byline (Organization), cover image, sources; publish 1-2 buyer-intent guides/month (pricing, กันร้อน, เลือกความหนา).

findings.title: English tree partial and weaker
findings.description: /en/index uses an old template; empty EN testimonials section renders as a visible bug; article bodies are Thai-only; no hreflang/canonical.
findings.recommendation: Bring /en/ to parity or scope it down deliberately; guard empty sections; translate article bodies or noindex /en/blog.

findings.title: Intent coverage gaps
findings.description: No pricing content, no มอก. page, no 'เมทัลชีทกันร้อน' pillar, no city/area pages, no FAQ content anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Build a pricing guide, a heat-insulation pillar, and Nong Khai / Udon Thani / Bueng Kan / Vientiane pages once real local content exists.

findings.title: Gallery alt text is sequential numbers
findings.description: 1,295 project photos carry only number alt text - the site's strongest asset is invisible to search and LLMs.
findings.recommendation: Caption 40-60 hero photos with real project type, system, province; template the rest.

findings.title: No on-site social proof / dead Facebook feed
findings.description: testimonials empty; facebook-posts.json = [] so the homepage feed never renders.
findings.recommendation: Collect 6-10 real testimonials with name/company/project; run pnpm run facebook to populate the feed.

findings.title: No dateModified on spec/price/product pages
findings.description: No freshness signal on pages where recency matters most.
findings.recommendation: Show a visible 'ปรับปรุงล่าสุด' date and emit dateModified in schema.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Homepage TH/EN titles carry the brand + 'หนองคาย / Nong Khai' + service area
Unique title, description, single H1 per page
Clean semantic heading structure

findings.title: No canonical / hreflang / OG (see Technical)
findings.description: On-page metadata layer is essentially just title + description.
findings.recommendation: Ship the BaseLayout head expansion.

findings.title: Inner-page titles/H1s are brand-only
findings.description: Beyond the homepage, titles/H1s lack product and geo modifiers.
findings.recommendation: Template titles as '{page topic} {product} | {brand} หนองคาย' and write descriptive H1s.

findings.title: H2s are slogans, not queries
findings.description: Money-page H2s ('พร้อมเริ่มโครงการหลังคาของคุณ?') don't match how buyers search and block passage extraction.
findings.recommendation: Use question-form H2s with a 40-60 word direct-answer lead block underneath.

findings.title: Weak internal linking, no breadcrumbs
findings.description: Money pages get only nav/footer links; no BreadcrumbList; no contextual guide<->spec<->product<->configurator links.
findings.recommendation: Add breadcrumbs + 3-5 contextual in-body links per money page.

findings.title: Indexable stub pages in main nav
findings.description: 'เร็ว ๆ นี้' Promotions (in nav), Vision, Maps, Hours stubs are indexable thin pages.
findings.recommendation: noindex until real; drop Promotions from nav until it has content.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Clean server-rendered HTML (no SPA rendering barrier for parsers)
astro.config site is set, so absolute @id / url values are free

findings.title: No Organization / LocalBusiness
findings.description: No business entity in any markup. Recommend type ['Organization','RoofingContractor'] (+ 'Manufacturer'); province-level areaServed (no street address yet); address = addressRegion + addressCountry; sameAs = Facebook + LINE; one contactPoint per phone; hasOfferCatalog of the 6 real products.
findings.recommendation: Add a <Schema> component in BaseLayout emitting an Organization + WebSite @graph on every page from site.ts.

findings.title: No WebSite node
findings.description: No WebSite entity (omit SearchAction - site has no search).
findings.recommendation: Include WebSite in the same @graph.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList
findings.description: 30+ pages with a 3-level mega-nav and no breadcrumb markup.
findings.recommendation: Generate BreadcrumbList from Astro.url.pathname for all pages at once.

findings.title: No BlogPosting on 3 posts
findings.description: Frontmatter present except author (use Organization) and cover image (none set - blocks Article rich result).
findings.recommendation: Emit BlogPosting from frontmatter; add cover images.

findings.title: No ItemList / Product on /products
findings.description: Model as ItemList of 6 Product nodes with NO offers (no public price, no checkout - valid, just no product rich result). Exclude the 7 comingSoon entries.
findings.recommendation: Add ItemList + Product nodes; do not fake Offer.price.

findings.title: No logo ImageObject / og:image
findings.description: 1024x1024 logo source exists at src/assets/brand/logo.png; not exposed as schema logo or OG image.
findings.recommendation: Copy an optimised /logo.png; reference in Organization.logo and og:image.

findings.title: No Person / Review / AggregateRating
findings.description: team.ts and testimonials.ts are deliberately empty - do not fabricate.
findings.recommendation: Add Person + Review markup once real content is published.

findings.title: Do NOT add FAQPage / HowTo
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites (May 2026) - no SERP feature. HowTo deprecated Sept 2023. FAQ-style CONTENT is still useful for users and AI answers, but add it as plain content or QAPage (genuine Q&A only), not FAQPage-for-SERP.
findings.recommendation: Skip FAQPage/HowTo schema; keep the Q&A content itself.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: CLS near-zero everywhere (0.004-0.039) - all images have explicit dimensions
TBT 0 ms on every page; INP estimated Good (<100ms) - zero JS hydration
Lighthouse lab: home 94 mobile / 99 desktop, configurator 99, products 91
FacebookUpdates is build-time static - no third-party JS / FB SDK

findings.title: LCP fails on mobile (lab)
findings.description: Home 2.9s, Products 3.3s mobile ('Needs Improvement'). Cause: hero image loading=lazy + fetchpriority=auto, not preloaded (264ms resource-load-delay).
findings.recommendation: loading=eager + fetchpriority=high + <link rel=preload as=image> on hero and first product image. Expect LCP -0.5 to -1.0s into Good.

findings.title: Render-blocking Google Fonts ~770-870ms
findings.description: Two Thai families, 8 weight files, cross-origin CSS. public/fonts/ empty (abandoned self-host).
findings.recommendation: Self-host + subset Thai+Latin, one family, 2-3 weights, preload critical face.

findings.title: Unoptimised gallery / FB-card images
findings.description: 500-568KB full-res with no srcset; homepage lazy-loads ~1.5MB of them; dist/gallery = 243MB.
findings.recommendation: Route through astro:assets (Image/Picture) with srcset + widths.

findings.title: Only WebP emitted
findings.description: No AVIF for hero/product images.
findings.recommendation: <Picture formats={['avif','webp']}> for hero + products (-25-35% bytes).

findings.title: /products TTFB spike
findings.description: 160ms vs 40ms on home for static HTML.
findings.recommendation: Add Vercel edge cache headers for static HTML.

findings.title: Dead 192KB React runtime
findings.description: dist/_astro/client.*.js built, referenced by zero pages.
findings.recommendation: Remove @astrojs/react or add the intended islands.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Clean static HTML, AI crawlers not blocked
Good structural readability (68) - real headings, real prose
Homepage entity basics present in visible text (name, phones, region, service area)

findings.title: Zero structured data (entity grounding)
findings.description: No LocalBusiness/Organization for an AI to attach 'metal roofing manufacturer, Nong Khai, Thai-Lao border' to. Single biggest GEO lever.
findings.recommendation: Ship Organization/RoofingContractor JSON-LD; grow address + sameAs as data lands.

findings.title: Authority signals near-empty (28/100)
findings.description: No Google Business Profile, no street address, no sameAs cluster, no Wikidata/Wikipedia, no author bylines, no named certifications, no YouTube/Reddit/directory mentions.
findings.recommendation: Verify GBP, publish the existing explainer animations to YouTube, get the real address, build the sameAs cluster.

findings.title: No robots.txt / sitemap discovery path
findings.description: AI crawlers not blocked but no discovery aid on a near-zero-inbound domain.
findings.recommendation: robots.txt with AI allow-list + Sitemap: line; @astrojs/sitemap.

findings.title: Low citability of core pages
findings.description: H2s are slogans; no 40-60 word direct-answer blocks; prices are 100% 'ask for quote'; specs are qualitative (no coating class, warranty years, wind data).
findings.recommendation: Add question H2s + direct-answer leads + quantified spec tables on /specifications, /about, /products (TH+EN).

findings.title: English pages leak Thai units
findings.description: /en/specifications renders '0.35 - 0.50 มม.' because specs.ts thickness is one hard-coded Thai string. Corrupts extraction for English AI queries; blog bodies Thai-only.
findings.recommendation: Split specs.ts fields into thTh/thEn (e.g. thicknessTh/thicknessEn).

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: Honestly low value today (no major LLM honors it) but cheap future-proofing.
findings.recommendation: Add public/llms.txt with a short business summary + key page links.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Explicit width/height on images -> near-zero CLS
WebP emitted by astro:assets for managed images
/gallery uses aspect-ratio pinning + eager/lazy split

findings.title: Gallery alt text is sequential numbers
findings.description: 1,295 project photos have number-only alt text; no descriptive or geo/keyword content.
findings.recommendation: Caption 40-60 primary photos with project type + system + province; template the rest.

findings.title: Oversized unmanaged images
findings.description: Gallery / FB-card images 500-568KB full-res , no srcset; ~1.5MB lazy-loaded on the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Route through astro:assets with responsive widths.

findings.title: No AVIF
findings.description: Only WebP for hero/product images.
findings.recommendation: Add AVIF via <Picture>.

findings.title: 3 CLIENT WORK images render blank
findings.description: 3 project webp tiles + a footer logo report naturalWidth 0 in the built site - empty navy boxes; kills a social-proof section. No 4xx - likely bad asset path.
findings.recommendation: Fix the asset paths; set loading=eager + width/height on the first row.

findings.title: No og:image
findings.description: No social share image.
findings.recommendation: Add a 1200x630 default og:image.

categories.name: Local SEO
what_works: Name + all 3 phones consistent everywhere with valid E.164 tel: hrefs
Homepage TH/EN titles carry 'หนองคาย / Nong Khai' + service area
branches.ts cleanly skips the empty address rather than faking one

findings.title: No street address anywhere
findings.description: Province only. Blocks GBP verification, citations, PostalAddress schema, and proximity ranking (~55% of local variance).
findings.recommendation: Publish the full factory address in branches.ts + a footer NAP block.

findings.title: No Google Business Profile signal
findings.description: No listing referenced; map is a 'เร็ว ๆ นี้' placeholder; no hours, no directions link. Primary GBP category (the #1 local ranking factor) is unset.
findings.recommendation: Create + verify a storefront GBP at the factory; primary category 'Roofing contractor' (or 'Roofing supply store'); secondaries Metal fabricator / Manufacturer / Insulation contractor; add service areas.

findings.title: Zero local structured data
findings.description: No LocalBusiness/Organization/WebSite/Breadcrumb; no canonical/og/hreflang/robots/sitemap.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization + WebSite in BaseLayout and a data-driven RoofingContractor/Manufacturer LocalBusiness node on /branches + /contact (address, geo 5-decimal, telephone, url, openingHoursSpecification, areaServed, sameAs).

findings.title: Facebook link is a personal profile
findings.description: profile.php?id=... - no NAP fields, no category, no reviews; unusable as a citation.
findings.recommendation: Convert to a Facebook Business Page; update site.ts facebookHref + schema sameAs.

findings.title: No Google review strategy
findings.description: Testimonials deliberately empty and pointed at Facebook; zero review velocity; no first-party or Google review signal.
findings.recommendation: Launch a Google review drive on GBP go-live (QR at install sign-off + LINE follow-up; 2-4/month, no >2-week gap).

findings.title: No directory citations
findings.description: Nothing on Longdo Map, yellowpages.co.th, thaitambon, wazzadu, Apple Maps, or coil-supplier dealer locators. Citation factors are 3 of the top 5 AI-visibility factors.
findings.recommendation: Build 8-12 consistent NAP citations on Thai directories after the address is published.

findings.title: Thin on-page geo beyond the homepage
findings.description: Inner-page titles/H1s are brand-only; footer has no NAP block; site on a vercel.app subdomain (weak for brand/citation matching).
findings.recommendation: Add geo modifiers to inner titles/H1s; footer NAP block; migrate to a .co.th/.com domain with 301s.

findings.title: Service-area pages are an opportunity, not yet buildable
findings.description: Nong Khai / Udon Thani / Bueng Kan / Vientiane pages are the #1 local-organic factor, but gallery projects carry no province tags so there is no unique local content to build them on.
findings.recommendation: Tag gallery projects by province first; then ship one substantive page per area (real projects, delivery notes, local specifics). Do not ship thin doorway pages.

categories.name: SXO (Search Experience)
what_works: /configurator is the correct page type (Tool) for calculator queries
Product taxonomy is coherent
Contractor-bulk and estimator personas are closest to served (50-52)

findings.title: Price opacity on the highest-volume commercial queries
findings.description: 'สอบถามราคา' on every product/spec row; competitors show ฿140-450/ตร.ม. Kills featured-snippet and AI-Overview eligibility for 'เมทัลชีท ราคา' / 'แผ่นหลังคาเหล็ก ราคา'.
findings.recommendation: Show real starting ฿/ตร.ม. ranges + 'อัปเดต ส.ค. 2026' on /specifications and /products; keep 'ขอใบเสนอราคา' as the CTA.

findings.title: /specifications page-type mismatch
findings.description: 193 words vs 1,000-2,500 word buyer guides (jorakay, BlueScope, SCG, Thaiwatsadu) + AI Overview that rank for 'เมทัลชีท คือ / ความหนา / เลือก'.
findings.recommendation: Expand into a 1,200+ word pillar guide + a small informational cluster.

findings.title: Homepage loses the local pack
findings.description: Ranks for 'เมทัลชีท หนองคาย / ใกล้ฉัน' but SERP rewards local pack + full-NAP vendor pages; no LocalBusiness schema, NAP below fold, no map, no reviews, vercel.app subdomain.
findings.recommendation: NAP + Maps embed + tap-to-call + review stars above the fold on / and /contact; link /branches from the header.

findings.title: Split language targeting
findings.description: /en/* tree has no hreflang, no canonical - orphaned / cannibalising EN pages.
findings.recommendation: hreflang th/en/x-default + self-canonicals everywhere.

findings.title: Trust proof never on the money pages
findings.description: Testimonials, technical-team, มอก., company reg exist as separate pages and never surface where the buying decision happens. Trust is the lowest-scoring dimension for all 6 personas.
findings.recommendation: Surface 2-3 testimonials, a certification badge row, and a team blurb on /products, /specifications, /services.

findings.title: Configurator withholds its output
findings.description: 86 words; shows 'ราคาโดยประมาณ' then routes to LINE instead of displaying the estimate; competitors display it. No supporting body copy.
findings.recommendation: Show the estimated price inline; add 'ดาวน์โหลดสเปก (PDF)'; add 150-300 words explaining inputs/assumptions.

findings.title: Generic CTAs
findings.description: 'พร้อมเริ่มโครงการหลังคาของคุณ?' regardless of page intent.
findings.recommendation: Intent-matched CTAs: 'ขอใบเสนอราคาโครงการ' / 'ดูราคาเริ่มต้น' / 'โทรเลย'.

findings.title: Weak internal linking + no breadcrumbs
findings.description: Money pages get only nav/footer links.
findings.recommendation: Contextual links + BreadcrumbList across guide <-> specs <-> products <-> configurator.

categories.name: Visual / Mobile UX
what_works: Hero gradient wash-out issue is FIXED - near-black Thai H1 fully legible at 1440 and 390
Clean editorial desktop layout
Near-zero CLS from disciplined image dimensions

findings.title: Mobile header collision
findings.description: 'หจก.มีชัยสตีล' wordmark overlaps / runs under the hamburger - looks broken on first paint.
findings.recommendation: Hide the text wordmark below ~480px (logo mark only).

findings.title: Mobile above-the-fold buries the offer
findings.description: ~570px hero image renders first; H1, value prop, product chips, primary CTA all below the fold.
findings.recommendation: Reorder: eyebrow + H1 + one-line prop + CTA above the image; cut hero image to ~240px.

findings.title: 3 CLIENT WORK images render blank
findings.description: webp tiles + footer logo report naturalWidth 0; empty navy boxes; kills the social-proof section.
findings.recommendation: Verify the 4 failing paths in public/; loading=eager + width/height on the first row.

findings.title: Mobile sticky contact bar overlaps content
findings.description: Fixed bottom bar covers the hero CTA; no bottom padding reserved on main.
findings.recommendation: padding-bottom = sticky-bar height + env(safe-area-inset-bottom) on the scroll container.

findings.title: Contrast failures (AA)
findings.description: Brand amber links on white at ~14-15px fail AA for normal text; hero photo overlay text has no scrim; section-02 navy-band body copy borderline.
findings.recommendation: Darken amber for body-size text/links or restrict amber to >=24px / bold >=18.66px; add a dark scrim behind hero-photo text. (Contrast numbers are screenshot estimates - re-run with oklch->sRGB.)

findings.title: Sub-44px tap targets
findings.description: Hamburger 32x40, TH/EN toggle 18x24, 'ออกแบบ 3D' 105x28; 19 sub-44px interactive elements on mobile.
findings.recommendation: Pad hamburger to 44x44; merge TH/EN into a 44px segmented control; bump 12px Thai labels to >=13-14px.

findings.title: No phone in desktop header
findings.description: Only LINE in the header; tel: links live ~4800px down.
findings.recommendation: Add a tap-to-call number to the desktop header.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes (crawl/index foundation + trust)
items: Add public/robots.txt (allow-all + AI-crawler allow + Sitemap: line)
